name: fibSum_eq
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => fib n + fib (n + 1)

def fibSum : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => fibSum n + fib n
statement: theorem fibSum_eq (n : Nat) : fibSum n + 1 = fib (n + 1)
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [fibSum, fib]; omega
  have recurrence (k : Nat) : fibSum (k + 2) = fibSum (k + 1) + fibSum k + 1 := by
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      simp only [fibSum] at ih ⊢
      rw [fib]
      omega
  have paired (k : Nat) : fibSum k + 1 = fib (k + 1) ∧ fibSum (k + 1) + 1 = fib (k + 2) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => decide
    | succ k ih =>
      constructor
      · exact ih.2
      · rw [recurrence]
        rw [show fib (k + 1 + 2) = fib (k + 1) + fib (k + 2) from rfl]
        omega
  exact (paired n).1
strategies: Direct induction using the Fibonacci recurrence.
Derive a recurrence for fibSum and use a strengthened pair of consecutive equalities.
